input: Rotate and balance the tires before the road trip

gold.taskTitle: Rotate and Balance Tires Before the Road Trip
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to get their vehicle's tires rotated and balanced in preparation for an upcoming road trip.

questions.title: When exactly is the road trip departure date?
questions.description: Establish the deadline so the tire service can be scheduled with enough lead time.

questions.title: Are you doing this yourself or hiring a shop?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a DIY job or requires finding and booking a professional service.

questions.title: Do you already have a preferred mechanic or tire shop?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a go-to shop or needs help identifying one nearby.

questions.title: What is the make, model, and year of the vehicle?
questions.description: Vehicle details may affect rotation pattern, balancing specs, and service pricing.

questions.title: How many miles are currently on the tires?
questions.description: Mileage helps assess whether the tires are due for rotation and if replacement should also be considered.

questions.title: Is there a budget limit for this service?
questions.description: Knowing a price range helps narrow down shop options or decide between DIY and professional service.

questions.title: Do you need a tire inspection included at the same time?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the scope of the visit should include a full inspection, tread depth check, or pressure adjustment.
